data.long_meaning: Harish is a popular Hindu name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Hari'. Hari is a name for Vishnu, the preserver in the Hindu Trimurti, and is also an epithet of Shiva, the destroyer. The name is believed to bestow the blessings of these powerful gods upon the bearer. The name Harish carries the meaning “God Hari” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Harish usually hope their child will grow to embody god hari and live with faith, good character and purpose.
